statement: Intel guided Q3 2026 revenue to $15.8-$16.8 billion, above the $15.1 billion analyst expectation, after Q2 revenue of $16.1 billion beat consensus by 11.64%.
why: Guidance set above consensus is the clearest forward statement a vendor makes about whether it expects demand to hold up next quarter.

impact.mechanism: Above-consensus forward revenue guidance signals the vendor sees continued order strength, supporting the demand track into the next quarter.

evidence.excerpt: Revenue range: "$15.8 billion to $16.8 billion" (above analyst expectations of $15.1 billion).

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: guidance range stated in Intel's own quarterly results press release.

dispersion: Guidance is a range of $15.8B to $16.8B; the value shown is the midpoint.
